f3_program: collection("ariana.bills", "bill", "ariana", source("Ariana is past due on three bills"))
observe(at("ariana.bills.count", "current"), 3, "count", source("Ariana is past due on three bills"))
member("ariana.bills", "ariana.bills.first", source("The first bill"))
observe(at("ariana.bills.first.balance", "initial"), 200, "currency", source("The first bill for $200"))
percent_of(at("ariana.bills.first.simple_interest.per_month.amount", "current"), at("ariana.bills.first.balance", "initial"), 10, source("charges 10% simple interest for each overdue month"))
observe(at("ariana.bills.first.overdue_duration", "current"), 2, "month", source("it's 2 months overdue"))

rate_relation(at("ariana.bills.first.simple_interest.total.amount", "current"), at("ariana.bills.first.simple_interest.per_month.amount", "current"), at("ariana.bills.first.overdue_duration", "current"), source("charges 10% simple interest for each overdue month and it's 2 months overdue"))

add("first_bill_interest_charge", "ariana.bills.first", at("ariana.bills.first.balance", "current"), at("ariana.bills.first.simple_interest.total.amount", "current"), source("The first bill for $200 charges 10% simple interest for each overdue month and it's 2 months overdue"))
member("ariana.bills", "ariana.bills.second", source("The second bill"))
observe(at("ariana.bills.second.balance", "initial"), 130, "currency", source("The second bill for $130"))
observe(at("ariana.bills.second.late_fee.per_month.amount", "current"), 50, "currency_per_month", source("charges a flat $50 late fee per month"))
observe(at("ariana.bills.second.overdue_duration", "current"), 6, "month", source("is 6 months overdue"))

rate_relation(at("ariana.bills.second.late_fee.total.amount", "current"), at("ariana.bills.second.late_fee.per_month.amount", "current"), at("ariana.bills.second.overdue_duration", "current"), source("charges a flat $50 late fee per month and is 6 months overdue"))

add("second_bill_late_fee_charge", "ariana.bills.second", at("ariana.bills.second.balance", "current"), at("ariana.bills.second.late_fee.total.amount", "current"), source("The second bill for $130 charges a flat $50 late fee per month and is 6 months overdue"))
member("ariana.bills", "ariana.bills.last", source("The last bill"))
observe(at("ariana.bills.last.balance", "initial"), 444, "currency", source("is for $444"))
observe(at("ariana.bills.last.overdue_duration", "current"), 2, "month", source("The last bill is two months late"))
add("last_bill_first_month_fee", "ariana.bills.last", at("ariana.bills.last.balance", "current"), 40, source("charges a $40 fee the first month overdue"))

add("last_bill_second_month_fee", "ariana.bills.last", at("ariana.bills.last.balance", "current"), scale(event_field("last_bill_first_month_fee", "quantity"), 2), source("twice that fee the second month overdue"))
query("sum", "ariana.bills", "current")
collection("publishing_house.contest.prizes", "award", "publishing_house.contest", source("award a total of $800 in prizes to the 18 novels with the most votes"))
observe(at("publishing_house.contest.prizes.count", "future"), 18, "count", source("the 18 novels with the most votes"))
observe(at("publishing_house.contest.prizes.total.amount", "future"), 800, "currency", source("a total of $800 in prizes"))
partition("publishing_house.contest.prizes", at("publishing_house.contest.prizes.total.amount", "future"), source("award a total of $800 in prizes to the 18 novels with the most votes"))
member("publishing_house.contest.prizes", "publishing_house.contest.prizes.first", source("First place"))
observe(at("publishing_house.contest.prizes.first.amount", "future"), 200, "currency", source("First place will get $200"))
member("publishing_house.contest.prizes", "publishing_house.contest.prizes.second", source("second place"))
observe(at("publishing_house.contest.prizes.second.amount", "future"), 150, "currency", source("second place will get $150"))
member("publishing_house.contest.prizes", "publishing_house.contest.prizes.third", source("third place"))
observe(at("publishing_house.contest.prizes.third.amount", "future"), 120, "currency", source("third place $120"))
collection("publishing_house.contest.prizes.fourth_onward", "award", "publishing_house.contest.prizes", source("the rest of the awards"))

same(at("publishing_house.contest.prizes.fourth_onward.member.amount", "future"), at("publishing_house.contest.prizes.fourth_onward.common.amount", "future"), source("the rest of the awards will be paid with the same amount of money"))
query("value", at("publishing_house.contest.prizes.fourth_onward.common.amount", "future"))
assumptions: Each awarded novel corresponds to one prize and one writer.
F3-v1 has no allowlisted conditional-threshold form for applying the 20% discount only if more than 10 ingots are bought.
The source does not establish whether the 10 decorations left to put up are separate from the 20 decorations the budget could buy, or whether the budget capacity will actually be used.

f3_program: collection("farmer.hog.offspring", "piglet", "farmer", source("a hog that recently gave birth to 6 piglets"))
produce("piglet_birth", "farmer.hog", at("farmer.hog.offspring.count", "current"), 6, source("hog that recently gave birth to 6 piglets"))
observe(at("farmer.hog.offspring.sale_price", "current"), 300, "currency_per_pig", source("sell the fully grown pig for $300"))
observe(at("farmer.hog.offspring.minimum_growth_duration", "current"), 12, "month", source("Each piglet must grow for at least 12 months before it is large enough to be sold"))
observe(at("farmer.hog.offspring.feed_cost_rate", "current"), 10, "currency_per_animal_month", source("It costs the farmer $10 per month to feed each animal until it is sold"))
remove("sale_after_12_months", "farmer", at("farmer.hog.offspring.count", "current"), 3, source("the farmer sells 3 pigs after 12 months"))
observe(at("farmer.hog.offspring.sale_after_12_months.growth_duration", "after_12_months"), 12, "month", source("sells 3 pigs after 12 months"))
remove("sale_after_16_months", "farmer", at("farmer.hog.offspring.count", "current"), 3, source("the remaining 3 pigs after 16 months"))
observe(at("farmer.hog.offspring.sale_after_16_months.growth_duration", "after_16_months"), 16, "month", source("the remaining 3 pigs after 16 months"))

product_relation(at("farmer.hog.offspring.sale_after_12_months.revenue.amount", "after_12_months"), event_field("sale_after_12_months", "quantity"), at("farmer.hog.offspring.sale_price", "current"), source("he can sell the fully grown pig for $300.  Each piglet must grow for at least 12 months before it is large enough to be sold. It costs the farmer $10 per month to feed each animal until it is sold.  If the farmer sells 3 pigs after 12 months"))

product_relation(at("farmer.hog.offspring.sale_after_16_months.revenue.amount", "after_16_months"), event_field("sale_after_16_months", "quantity"), at("farmer.hog.offspring.sale_price", "current"), source("he can sell the fully grown pig for $300.  Each piglet must grow for at least 12 months before it is large enough to be sold. It costs the farmer $10 per month to feed each animal until it is sold.  If the farmer sells 3 pigs after 12 months, and the remaining 3 pigs after 16 months"))

product_relation(at("farmer.hog.offspring.sale_after_12_months.food_cost.amount", "after_12_months"), at("farmer.hog.offspring.feed_cost_rate", "current"), at("farmer.hog.offspring.sale_after_12_months.growth_duration", "after_12_months"), event_field("sale_after_12_months", "quantity"), source("It costs the farmer $10 per month to feed each animal until it is sold.  If the farmer sells 3 pigs after 12 months"))

product_relation(at("farmer.hog.offspring.sale_after_16_months.food_cost.amount", "after_16_months"), at("farmer.hog.offspring.feed_cost_rate", "current"), at("farmer.hog.offspring.sale_after_16_months.growth_duration", "after_16_months"), event_field("sale_after_16_months", "quantity"), source("It costs the farmer $10 per month to feed each animal until it is sold.  If the farmer sells 3 pigs after 12 months, and the remaining 3 pigs after 16 months"))

sum_relation(at("farmer.hog.offspring.sales.revenue.total.amount", "after_16_months"), at("farmer.hog.offspring.sale_after_12_months.revenue.amount", "after_12_months"), at("farmer.hog.offspring.sale_after_16_months.revenue.amount", "after_16_months"), source("If the farmer sells 3 pigs after 12 months, and the remaining 3 pigs after 16 months, how much profit did he earn in total"))

sum_relation(at("farmer.hog.offspring.food_cost.total.amount", "after_16_months"), at("farmer.hog.offspring.sale_after_12_months.food_cost.amount", "after_12_months"), at("farmer.hog.offspring.sale_after_16_months.food_cost.amount", "after_16_months"), source("the farmer sells 3 pigs after 12 months, and the remaining 3 pigs after 16 months, how much profit did he earn in total (after deducting the cost of food)"))
query("difference", at("farmer.hog.offspring.food_cost.total.amount", "after_16_months"), at("farmer.hog.offspring.sales.revenue.total.amount", "after_16_months"))
assumptions: "each animal" refers to each of the six offspring being raised for sale, excluding the mother hog.
